K2_reason: Per-sample raw-TPM 8-gene RAI score does not align directionally with the classifier-internal centered-profile p_DM2 (Spearman ρ=+0.33 vs expected negative). Per memory v17_korean_k2_calibration: 8-gene mini-index TPM inflates 10-100× and only the within-sample-centered profile is calibrated. Including K2 in raw-score meta is invalid; K2 evidence enters via classifier DM call distribution (246 DM2 / 14 DM1) which is consistent with a predominantly Hashimoto-included Korean PTC cohort.

K2_alt_evidence.interpretation: Korean K2 cohort 94.6% DM2 — extremely high vs TCGA's 360/500=72%. Consistent with elevated Hashimoto background in Korean population, supporting the Hashimoto-overlap PTC sub-axis hypothesis.
